Estimate, not a measurement: 0.6 Wh per 1k output tokens (0.12 prefill, 0.012 cache replay —
the ratios providers price these at), scaled by model size. That rate reproduces Google's
published 0.24 Wh median text prompt. Energy becomes water at 1.08 mL/Wh of datacenter cooling
plus 1.8 mL/Wh consumed generating the electricity, at the US grid average. Long-context
attention is not priced separately, which biases this low on deep sessions. Assume plus or
